title: Capture Framing Guide
description: How to get the right camera distance and angle for artifact screenshots. Three zoom levels, pick the best.
earned_from: capture pipeline fixes: 2.0x→1.0x, zoom sweep, camera override

nodes.label: Run capture_multi_angle.gd
nodes.detail: Outputs 3 zoom levels per angle: _far (1.4x), _mid (1.0x), _close (0.65x). Default = far.

nodes.label: Is the default (far) good?
nodes.detail: Should fill 40-70% of frame. If artifact is tiny, something is wrong.

nodes.label: Check: artifact creating own Camera3D?
nodes.detail: JointDemoBase, many demos create Camera3D with current=true. The capture script disables these — if not, the artifact camera overrides.

nodes.label: Pick best from 3 zoom levels
nodes.detail: far = catalog shot (whole artifact), mid = hero shot (fills frame), close = detail (texture/mechanism)
